title: How a family reunion in China ended in a 3-year prison term for artist Gao Zhen

Gao's wife expressed deep disappointment and sadness over the unexpected conviction.  His supporters argue the artworks predate the law under which he was prosecuted. title: Mark Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125 million school to shut after 10 years

The cessation of funding from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative forced the board to make this difficult choice. Although the school offered a variety of support services, its academic performance failed to consistently align with state standards. Students will transfer to the Ravenswood City Elementary School District, with support provided for their educational transition.

title: '3,000 raids, rats, cockroaches': How FDA chief is giving eateries a wake-up call

His teams have conducted over 3,000 raids, suspending permits and uncovering numerous violations.  The campaign now targets loose edible oil sales, enforcing regulations from 2011.  Traders express concern over mandatory packaging, while the FDA cites adulteration risks.  The FDA seized over Rs 5 crore worth of edible oil during recent inspections.

title: Lunar eclipse on Raksha Bandhan? Sutak not needed for Rakhi in India

Secure shipping routes are essential for uninterrupted movement of vital commodities globally. Conflicts and attacks on maritime routes threaten food and energy supplies worldwide. India stressed the need for unimpeded humanitarian access and objective supply chain assessments. Strengthening domestic agriculture and diversifying supply chains are crucial for food security.

content: EPF can form the stable or debt portion of a retirement portfolio. For FY 2025-26, an interest rate of 8.25% has been recommended for EPF accounts.

title: Iran Blacklists Indian, Pakistani Ships Among 45 For Hormuz "Violations"
content: One-third of the vessels Iran has threatened to confiscate for breaching Strait of Hormuz transit rules have already been attacked during the Middle East war, an AFP data analysis found.

title: 'Warned by FBI, Canadian police of credible plot': Pannun claims fresh threat to life
content: sikhs for justice general counsel of SFJ said he was warned by both the FBI and the royal Canadian Mounted police of a 'new credible threat' to his life . he said the agency asked him to notify them in advance if they did make any travel plans .

title: 6,500-year-old human tooth found in Serbian museum collection
content: archeologists found a tiny, worn tooth measuring only 23 millimeters . it sat on a museum shelf for nearly twenty years, unseen, mistaken for something far more common . the bizarre artifact was unearthed at the Neolithic site of Jablanica, in Serbia .

title: Was PoK's Skardu airbase India's next target after Sargodha? Ex-CDS explains why plans changed
content: former chief of defence staff general anil Chauhan made the remarks while speaking at the Vivekananda International Foundation . he said Indian forces had cleared Skardu in Gilgit-Baltistan as a possible target during Operation Sindoor .

title: 15 newborns killed after fire breaks out at Islamabad hospital in Pakistan
content: 15 newborns died after a fire broke out in the gynaecology ward of the hospital . the fire reportedly started after an air-conditioner compressor exploded inside the nursery . only one baby was rescued from the ward .

title: House price growth slows to 3.6% in Q1 FY27, says RBI; what’s driving the moderation
content: the all-India house price index rose to 117.5 in Q1 FY27, from 116.2 in Q4 FY26 and 113.4 in the year-ago quarter . on a quarter-on-quarter basis, the index increased 1.1 per cent . however, the slower annual growth suggests that the sharp momentum seen in some housing markets has eased .

title: LS Speaker seeks response from 20 rebel TMC MPs on disqualification petitions
content: 20 rebels are now affiliated with the little-known nationalist Citizens Party of India (NCPI) the disqualification petitions are currently pending before Birla . this comes after solicitor general of India Tushar Mehta informed the Supreme Court that the Speaker had already issued notices to the 20 MPs .
